prompt: What does the sign-out card list?

options.text: The names of the volunteers working today.
options.whyZh: 卡上列的是工具名稱，沒有列出值班志工的名字。

options.text: The numbers of the common tables.
options.whyZh: 公用桌只在說明剪刀位置時提到，卡並不列桌號。

options.text: Small items that may be taken home.
options.whyZh: 錄音直接說卡上列出可以帶走的小工具。

options.text: Tools to be purchased next Saturday.
options.whyZh: 下週六是歸還時間，不是買工具的時間。

explanationZh: 錄音直接說卡上列出可以帶走的小工具。
evidence: The card lists the small items that can go home with you.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The card lists the small items that can go home with you.

vocabulary.note: 用來記錄哪些物品可借出或已借出。
